gloss_en: "He stretches out the heavens like a curtain" (noteh shamayim ka-yeri'ah, Psalms 104:2) — the scriptural phrase describing God spreading the heavens, expounded in Likutey Moharan I:54 as the aspect of the unification of the Tzaddik and Knesset Yisrael, manifested in business dealings (masa u'matan)
